name: ms-m/github-theme-updater
description: Updates a WordPress theme straight from a GitHub repository, with backups, rollback and per-path protection.

scripts.lint: @php -r "foreach (new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator('.')) as $f) { if ($f->isFile() && $f->getExtension() === 'php' && strpos($f->getPathname(), 'vendor') === false) { passthru(PHP_BINARY . ' -l ' . escapeshellarg($f->getPathname()), $c); if ($c) exit(1); } } echo 'No syntax errors.' . PHP_EOL;"

scripts-descriptions.lint: Runs php -l over every plugin file.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Checks the code against the WordPress coding standards.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Fixes what phpcs can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.check: Runs lint, phpcs, phpstan and the test suite.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Runs static analysis at PHPStan level 6.
